name: binhex-plex
description: The Plex Media Server enriches your life by organizing all your personal media, presenting it beautifully and streaming it to all of your devices. It's easy to use, it's awesome, and it's free!

paths.name: /config
paths.description: This is the container path to your configuration files, e.g. databases, configuration files, logs etc.

paths.name: /media
paths.description: This is the container path to your media files, e.g. movies, tv, music, pictures etc.

variables.name: TRANS_DIR
variables.description: Specify the path to store temporary transcode files.

variables.name: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
variables.description: Specify whether this container can use all Nvidia driver capabilities for transcoding, if you have a Nvidia card set this to 'all'.

variables.name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
variables.description: Specify the Nvidia GPU device id for transcoding, format will be 'GPU-xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.

variables.name: CLAIM_SERVER
variables.description: Specify whether to claim the Plex server on startup.

variables.name: PLEX_CLAIM
variables.description: Specify the Plex Claim Code to retrieve your Plex Server, Claim Codes can be generated from https://plex.tv/claim - Note Claim Codes expire after 4 minutes.

variables.name: HEALTHCHECK_COMMAND
variables.description: The command or script to execute, if not specified then the script healthcheck.sh will be used (process, dns and https checking).

variables.name: HEALTHCHECK_ACTION
variables.description: The action to execute if the healthcheck command returns a non zero exit code, if not specified the action will be 'exit 1', if you want the container to exit on failure then set the action to 'kill 1'.

variables.name: HEALTHCHECK_HOSTNAME
variables.description: The hostname used when performing HTTPS and DNS healthchecking.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for the running container

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for the running container

gpus.description: NVIDIA GPU pass-through. Requires the NVIDIA driver / container toolkit on the host (Unraid: install the Nvidia-Driver plugin).

author: binhex
